audit.whatIsWrong: The entry promises blind uptime it cannot deliver: spikes[1].text "Maxed Q cooldown lets you blind Trundle every time he walks up for CS", whys[3] "Max-rank Q lets you blind Trundle nearly every time he steps up", mid "your Blinding Shot cooldown is low enough to deny almost every Chomp attempt".
audit.why: Chomp is a flat 3.5s cooldown and Blinding Dart is a flat 7s at every rank. Trundle gets roughly two Chomps per blind, and ranking Q up never changes that because Teemo's Q cooldown does not scale — only the blind duration does. The entry's core promise is therefore backwards, and a player who believes it will stand in a second bite expecting a blind that is still 3.5s away.
audit.corrected: Chomp 3.5s vs Blinding Dart 7s — you blank one bite in two. Blind the Chomp that opens a trade, then leave before the next one.

audit.whatIsWrong: Subjugate is described as stealing magic resist only: spikes[2].text "steals a chunk of your MR", whys[4] "drains your MR", wants.foe[2] "to drain your MR".
audit.why: Subjugate steals a percent of the target's Health, Armour AND Magic Resistance, and doubles the stolen amount over 4 seconds. Calling it an MR drain understates it by two thirds and hides the health component, which is the part that actually swings a low-HP duel.
audit.corrected: Subjugate steals Health, Armour and Magic Resistance together, doubling over 4s.

audit.whatIsWrong: King's Tribute is referred to only as "Trundle's innate healing" / "innate sustain" with no mechanism given.
audit.why: King's Tribute heals him for a percent of the maximum health of any enemy unit that dies near him — including minions. That means poking Trundle while a large wave is dying next to him is close to free for him, which is a concrete wave-management consequence the entry never draws. It is also the reason anti-heal timing matters before the fight rather than during it.
audit.corrected: King's Tribute heals him off every minion that dies near him — do not spend poke into a dying wave.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing notes that Chomp is an auto-attack reset.
audit.why: Chomp resets his attack timer, so his trade opens with an immediate bite rather than a wind-up — the tell is the reset, not a cast animation. Blinding Dart is best spent on that opener because it eats both the reset and the AD steal.
audit.corrected: Chomp is an auto-reset — the trade opens instantly. Blind the opener.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization advice never accounts for Subjugate interacting with the resistances Teemo buys.
audit.why: Subjugate steals a percent of current Armour and Magic Resist, so resistances bought against Trundle are partially handed to him when he ults. That is a genuine argument for leaning on percent-health burn and anti-heal over raw MR stacking in this specific matchup.
audit.corrected: Percent-health burn and anti-heal scale better than raw resistances here, because Subjugate takes a cut of whatever you stack.

audit.whatIsWrong: "Blinding Shot" in spikes[0].text, early, mid; whys[6] says "do not duel without Liandry's active".
audit.why: Teemo's Q is Blinding Dart. Liandry's has no active component, so "Liandry's active" is not a thing a player can hold or use.

edits.before: Blinding Shot already negates Trundle's Chomp auto-reliance; two autos into a Q means he takes full E poison and loses every early trade.
edits.after: Blinding Dart blanks a Chomp, but Chomp is 3.5s against your flat 7s — he gets two bites per blind, so spend it on the one that opens the trade.

edits.before: Maxed Q cooldown lets you blind Trundle every time he walks up for CS, stacking poison while he bleeds without landing a meaningful auto.
edits.after: Blinding Dart stays 7s at every rank while Chomp sits at 3.5s — blind the bite that starts his trade, never the one that finishes it.

edits.before: Subjugate steals a chunk of your MR and heals Trundle — never let him land R when you are low on W movement speed.
edits.after: Subjugate steals your Health, Armour and MR at once and doubles it over 4s — never let him land R while your W burst is down.

edits.before: Blind Chomp before it lands so Trundle steals no AD and takes full poison damage back
edits.after: Blind the Chomp opening his trade — it is an auto-reset, so the blind eats the AD steal

edits.before: Keep the wave on your side of lane so Trundle must march through your E range to reach CS
edits.after: Hold the wave your side; never poke into a dying wave, since King's Tribute heals him off it

edits.before: Hit Subjugate at low HP to drain your MR and heal into a full duel he wins without your kite room
edits.after: Hit Subjugate at low HP to steal your Health, Armour and MR at once and win the duel outright

edits.before: Level 1 you auto-poke once then immediately Q whenever Trundle steps up for CS — Blinding Shot makes his Chomp auto miss, so he steals zero AD and takes your full E poison in return. He has no dash, no gap-close, and his W domain only matters if he is already in melee range, so keep the minion wave just on your side of lane and never let him herd you into the domain with his Pillar of Ice cutting off your escape. If he opens W and steps in, Q him and back off with your W movement-speed burst before the domain expires; he will not catch you on a fresh Move Quick.
edits.after: Level 1 you auto-poke once then immediately Q whenever Trundle steps up for CS — Blinding Dart makes his Chomp auto miss, so he steals zero AD and takes your full E poison in return. Chomp is only 3.5s against your flat 7s, so blind the bite that opens a trade rather than expecting to deny them all. He has no dash and his W domain only matters if he is already in melee range, so keep the minion wave just on your side of lane and never let him herd you into the domain with his Pillar of Ice cutting off your escape. King's Tribute also heals him off every minion dying near him, so poke into a thin wave.

edits.before: By Levels 4-5 your Blinding Shot cooldown is low enough to deny almost every Chomp attempt and your E poison is stacking on every poke, so Trundle is bleeding HP without being able to auto-trade back. Mushroom the tribush and the river entrance now so he cannot safely rotate to invade your jungle or fight your jungler without wasting Flash or burning HP through shrooms. At Level 6 he gains Subjugate — do not duel him when your W is on cooldown and your HP is below 60%, because R drains enough of your MR that his sustained autos start to hurt; instead, shroom a wall behind you and force him to walk through poison just to reach you.
edits.after: By Levels 4-5 your Blinding Dart is still a flat 7s while Chomp is 3.5s, so you blank the bite that opens each trade and walk before the next one lands, stacking E poison on every exchange. Mushroom the tribush and the river entrance now so he cannot safely rotate to invade your jungle or fight your jungler without wasting Flash or burning HP through shrooms. At Level 6 he gains Subjugate — do not duel him when your W is on cooldown and your HP is below 60%, because R takes a slice of your Health, Armour and MR together; instead, shroom a wall behind you and force him to walk through poison just to reach you.

edits.before: Trundle's Level 1 kit is Chomp — a single auto that steals AD. Blind it immediately and he takes E poison for zero trade-back.
edits.after: Trundle's Level 1 kit is Chomp, an auto-reset that steals AD on a 3.5s timer. Blind the opener — you cannot blank every bite.

edits.before: Max-rank Q lets you blind Trundle nearly every time he steps up for a minion, stacking poison until he is too low to safely walk to CS.
edits.after: Blinding Dart is 7s flat at every rank against Chomp's 3.5s, so choose the bite you blank and stack poison on the walk-up you punish.

edits.before: Subjugate is online and drains your MR — avoid extended duels when your W is on cooldown; shroom the exit and kite rather than stand and fight.
edits.after: Subjugate steals your Health, Armour and MR together — avoid extended duels when your W is down; shroom the exit and kite rather than stand and fight.

edits.before: Trundle can reach item power too — do not duel without Liandry's active and always have a shroom wall behind you so Pillar of Ice cannot trap you cleanly.
edits.after: Trundle reaches item power too — do not duel without Liandry's completed, and always keep a shroom wall behind you so Pillar of Ice cannot trap you cleanly.

edits.before: - Trundle Subjugate: matchup-defining — Steals your stats. Avoid the brawl. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Trundle Subjugate: matchup-defining — it steals your Health, Armour and MR at once. Avoid the brawl. - Chomp: 3.5s auto-reset, twice as fast as your flat 7s blind. - Pillar of Ice: 21s at rank 1.

edits.before: Track Trundle's Subjugate: Steals your stats. Avoid the brawl. When it is down — Blind + poke him.
edits.after: Chomp is a 3.5s auto-reset against your flat 7s blind — blank the bite that opens the trade.

notes: Naming inconsistency worth a decision: this file calls the same item three different things — "Liandry's Angueur" (sion, sylas, tahmkench content), "Liandry's Anguish" (trundle content late) and "Liandry's Torment" (full-layer Itemization everywhere). I normalised the clearly-invalid "Angueur" to "Torment" to match the full layer, and left "Anguish" alone since it is at least a real historical name — but you should pick one and sweep it. The Chomp-3.5s-vs-blind-7s error also looks templated across Teemo entries: any matchup promising "blind every auto" against a sub-7s auto-reset needs the same check. WKM_LINES not inspected.
